cgu.title: Terms of Service
cgu.intro: By using ViteComm, you confirm that you have read, understood and accepted all of the following terms of service.
cgu.subtitle: Online commerce platform connecting customers, vendors and drivers
cgu.s1.title: 1. Purpose and acceptance
cgu.s1.content: These Terms of Service (ToS) govern the use of the ViteComm platform, an online marketplace connecting customers, vendors and drivers in Benin. By creating an account or using ViteComm, you unconditionally accept these terms. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the platform.
cgu.s2.title: 2. Registration and user account
cgu.s2.content: Registration is open to any individual residing in Benin. Three types of accounts are available: Customer (purchasing goods), Vendor (selling goods) and Driver (delivering orders). Each user must provide accurate and up-to-date information. Only one account per person is allowed. The user is responsible for the confidentiality of their login credentials.
cgu.s3.title: 3. Account verification and security
cgu.s3.content: Registration requires email verification by code. ViteComm reserves the right to suspend or ban any account in case of suspicious activity, violation of these terms, or attempted fraud. In case of password loss, an email reset procedure is available.
cgu.s4.title: 4. Customer obligations
cgu.s4.content: The customer commits to placing serious orders and making payment according to the proposed terms (Mobile Money via FedaPay). The customer has a right of withdrawal and can report any quality or compliance issue through the dispute system. The customer rates deliveries and vendors after each transaction.
cgu.s5.title: 5. Vendor obligations
cgu.s5.content: The vendor commits to providing products that match their descriptions, maintaining up-to-date stock, and validating orders within the allotted time. The vendor has a reputation score (out of 100) calculated based on product quality and customer ratings. A vendor with a score below 30/100 is subject to automatic reporting. The vendor is responsible for product availability.
cgu.s6.title: 6. Driver obligations
cgu.s6.content: The driver commits to making deliveries as quickly as possible and safely. The driver must collect merchandise only after vendor validation, and can only finalize a delivery after customer confirmation via a verification code. The driver has a reputation score and a modifiable availability status.
cgu.s7.title: 7. Payments and pricing
cgu.s7.content: Payments are made exclusively via Mobile Money (MTN, Moov, Celtis) through the secure FedaPay platform. Payment is triggered after delivery and customer inspection. ViteComm charges a commission on each transaction between 2% and 7% depending on delivery distance. Delivery fees are calculated automatically based on the distance between the market and the delivery address.
cgu.s8.title: 8. Disputes and conflict resolution
cgu.s8.content: In case of a problem (defective product, non-compliance, incomplete delivery), the customer or vendor can open a dispute. The administration has 48 hours to decide. Possible decisions are: full refund, partial refund, dispute rejection, or order cancellation. The affected vendor is notified and their reputation score may be impacted.
cgu.s9.title: 9. Reports
cgu.s9.content: Any user can report inappropriate behavior (offensive content, attempted fraud, harassment). Reports are reviewed by the administration. Depending on severity, sanctions range from warning to permanent account suspension. Unfounded reports may be dismissed.
cgu.s10.title: 10. Personal data protection
cgu.s10.content: ViteComm collects personal data necessary for platform operation (name, email, delivery address). This data is never sold to third parties. It is used only for: account management, order processing, sending verification codes, and service improvement. In accordance with Beninese law, you have the right to access, rectify and delete your data.
cgu.s11.title: 11. Intellectual property
cgu.s11.content: All platform content (logo, design, source code, databases) is the exclusive property of ViteComm or its partners. Any reproduction, even partial, is prohibited without prior written authorization.
cgu.s12.title: 12. Limitation of liability
cgu.s12.content: ViteComm acts as an intermediary between customers, vendors and drivers. The platform is not a party to commercial transactions between users. ViteComm cannot be held liable for product defects, delivery delays, or disputes between users, except in case of proven failure in its control obligations.
cgu.s13.title: 13. Modification of ToS
cgu.s13.content: ViteComm reserves the right to modify these ToS at any time. Users will be notified of any substantial modification. Continued use of the platform after notification constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
cgu.s14.title: 14. Applicable law and jurisdiction
cgu.s14.content: These ToS are subject to Beninese law. In case of dispute, the parties commit to seeking an amicable solution before any legal action. Failing that, the dispute will be submitted to the competent courts of Porto-Novo, Republic of Benin.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how ViteComm collects, uses and protects your personal data when using its online commerce platform.
privacy.s1.title: 1. Data collected
privacy.s1.content: ViteComm collects the following personal data during registration and platform use: name, email address, delivery address, profile photo (optional), and transaction data (order history, payments). This data is collected solely for the operation of the platform.
privacy.s2.title: 2. Data usage
privacy.s2.content: Your personal data is used for: creating and managing your user account, processing and tracking your orders, delivering merchandise (sharing your address with the relevant driver and vendor), sending verification codes and email notifications, calculating vendor and driver reputation scores, improving our services and user experience, and complying with our legal obligations.
privacy.s3.title: 3. Storage and security
privacy.s3.content: Your data is stored on secure, encrypted servers. ViteComm implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or disclosure. Your password is hashed and never stored in plain text. In case of a data breach affecting you, you will be notified as soon as possible.
privacy.s4.title: 4. Data sharing with third parties
privacy.s4.content: Your data may be shared with the following parties within the strict scope of ViteComm's operation: vendors (name, delivery address, order number), drivers (name, delivery address, order number), FedaPay (transaction data for Mobile Money payment processing), and competent authorities in case of legal obligation. Your data is never sold to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.s5.title: 5. Cookies
privacy.s5.content: ViteComm uses cookies strictly necessary for platform operation (user session, preferences). We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies. You can manage cookie settings in your browser, but some platform features may not work correctly if cookies are disabled.
privacy.s6.title: 6. User rights
privacy.s6.content: In accordance with Beninese data protection legislation, you have the following rights: right of access (view the data we hold about you), right to rectification (correct inaccurate or incomplete data), right to deletion (request the deletion of your account and data), right to object (object to the processing of your data for specific purposes). To exercise these rights, contact us at the address below.
privacy.s7.title: 7. Data retention
privacy.s7.content: Your personal data is retained for the entire duration of your account on ViteComm. After account deletion, your personal data will be deleted within 30 days, except for transaction data that we are required to retain for legal obligations (retention for 5 years in accordance with current regulations).
privacy.s8.title: 8. Policy changes
privacy.s8.content: ViteComm reserves the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. In case of substantial changes, you will be notified by email or via a platform notification. Continued use of ViteComm after notification constitutes acceptance of the modified policy.
privacy.s9.title: 9. Contact
privacy.s9.content: For any questions regarding the protection of your personal data or to exercise your rights, you can contact us at: sissolionel@gmail.com. We commit to responding to your request within 30 days.
